nodes.title: Verify OpenCode V2 lifecycle and conformance
Verify OpenCode V1 lifecycle and conformance
Define the v0.1 adoption, installation, and mutation contract
Run an external adoption pilot and fresh conformance suite

body:
## Objective

Accept the integrated shared OpenCode installation surface with separate V1 and V2 evidence against the approved v0.1 contract.

## Bounded Scope

### Allowed

- Review completed shared adapter, V1 setup/lifecycle, and V2 setup/lifecycle evidence from the bounded implementation work.
- Score the current installed-package matrix separately for V1 1.18.29+ and V2 2.0.4+, including both below-floor negative cases.
- Rerun a verification seam when its adapter, guide, host, upstream, or GitHub CLI input changed after the owning evidence was captured; correct an integration defect needed to meet the approved contract.

### Out of Scope

- Implement Codex or Claude Code metadata.
- Copy Backplane skill text or vendor upstream Superpowers.
- Require a consuming-project runtime, GitHub Projects, or IssueOps.
- Treat closed prerequisites or ownership assignments as proof of passing live host runs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The shared adapter and four variant-specific prerequisites are each closed with reason completed; one canonical adapter supports V1 plugin and V2 plugins configuration.
- V1 and V2 each have a separate matrix whose mandatory supported-host rows are PASS; FAIL or UNKNOWN blocks acceptance. Each row records host version, Backplane revision, upstream source/version or revision, gh capability, and three separate installed skill identities.
- Each supported variant has evidence for clean installation, native/sibling/absent-upstream setup, repeat installation, pinned update, rollback, Backplane-only uninstall, failure preservation, five named conformance checks, and authorized issue-state scenarios against integrated source. Changed inputs cause the affected seam to be rerun.
- V1 below 1.18.29 and V2 below 2.0.4 each produce the expected unsupported result without mutation. Fresh supported sessions discover upstream using-superpowers and both Backplane skills from separate installations; unrelated plugins, user files, upstream, repository history, and issue state remain intact.

## Verification Seams

- Compare the approved contract and current owner matrix with both integrated variant records, exact guide commands, adapter source, and evidence links. Require PASS for mandatory supported-host checks and expected unsupported outcomes below each floor; do not infer PASS from issue state.
- Confirm separate V1/V2 fresh-session, lifecycle, five-check, and authorized status/selection/design/readiness/execution/blocked/resume/review/completion results. Require zero read-only mutation, one Backplane label per open tracked issue, preservation of unrelated labels, and completed closure only after integration.
- Record the native and below-floor host versions, Backplane and upstream revisions, gh capability, three installed skill identities, and PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN for each operation and negative case.

## Superpowers Artifacts

Functional design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-v0.1-adoption-installation-contract-design.md (approved 2026-09-19).
Rescope design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-host-installation-leaf-rescoping-design.md.
Plan: not yet created.
